description: This file defines the Network class, which is part of a plugin system for network management within the WPEFramework. It declares methods for network interface control, IP settings, connectivity monitoring, and event handling, as well as internal data members and interface mappings.

classes.name: Network
classes.description: A plugin class for network management that inherits from PluginHost::IPlugin and PluginHost::JSONRPC, providing various network-related functionalities and event subscriptions.

methods.name: getInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves network interface information based on provided parameters.

methods.name: isInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specified network interface is enabled.

methods.name: setInterfaceEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Gets the current default network interface.

methods.name: setDefaultInterface
methods.description: Sets a specified interface as the default network interface.

methods.name: doTrace
methods.description: Performs a trace route operation.

methods.name: doPing
methods.description: Performs a ping test.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings.

methods.name: getIPSettings2
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings (alternative method).

methods.name: isConnectedToInternet
methods.description: Checks for internet connectivity.

methods.name: setConnectivityTestEndpoints
methods.description: Configures endpoints for connectivity testing.

methods.name: getInternetConnectionState
methods.description: Gets the current internet connection state.

methods.name: startConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Starts monitoring internet connectivity.

methods.name: getCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Retrieves the URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: stopConnectivityMonitoring
methods.description: Stops connectivity monitoring.

methods.name: getPublicIP
methods.description: Retrieves the device's public IP address.

methods.name: setStunEndpoint
methods.description: Sets the STUN endpoint for NAT traversal.

methods.name: getStbIp
methods.description: Gets the IP address of the set-top box.

methods.name: getSTBIPFamily
methods.description: Retrieves the IP family configuration for the set-top box.

methods.name: ReportonInterfaceStateChange
methods.description: Reports interface state changes.

methods.name: ReportonActiveInterfaceChange
methods.description: Reports active interface changes.

methods.name: ReportonIPAddressChange
methods.description: Reports IP address changes.

methods.name: ReportonInternetStatusChange
methods.description: Reports internet status changes.

ctags.name: Network
ctags.pattern: /^        class Network : public PluginHost::IPlugin, public PluginHost::JSONRPC$/
